trans-unit.id: Air pollution output is divided by this to determine PPM. It depends on AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 and the world area. For 1km2 and pressure 1kg/m2, 1 ton = 1PPM (part per million), which is the unit that determines climate change effects.
trans-unit.source: Air pollution output is divided by this to determine PPM. It depends on AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 and the world area. For 1km2 and pressure 1kg/m2, 1 ton = 1PPM (part per million), which is the unit that determines climate change effects.
trans-unit.target: La produzione di inquinamento atmosferico è divisa da ciò per determinare i PPM. Dipende da AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 e l'area del mondo. Per 1km2 e pressione di 1kg/m2, 1 T = 1PPM (parte per milione), l'unità determinante gli effetti del cambiamento climatico.

trans-unit.id: How much PPM (particles per million) will be added to/removed from atmosphere per one tone of matter (i.e. CO2).
trans-unit.source: How much PPM (particles per million) will be added to/removed from atmosphere per one tone of matter (i.e. CO2).
trans-unit.target: Quanti PPM (particelle per milione) saranno aggiunte a/rimosse dall'atmosfera per una tonnellata di materia (es. CO2).

trans-unit.id: Atmosphere pressure used in the atmosphere size formula. Trees absorb and pollution from tables produced in tons and converted to PPM by dividing on total atmosphere size. AtmosphereSizeInTons = WorldAreaInM2 * AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 where WorldAreaInM2 = (Dimensions.x * 10) * (Dimensions.y * 10). In example for 1km² (1000000m²) world with atmosphere pressure 1 kg/m² it will be 1000000 tons, resulting in 1 PPM per 1 ton of pollution or absorb (1 PPM = 1000000 * tons / AtmosphereSizeInTons), increasing pressure to 2 will result in 0.5 PPM per ton.
trans-unit.source: Atmosphere pressure used in the atmosphere size formula. Trees absorb and pollution from tables produced in tons and converted to PPM by dividing on total atmosphere size. AtmosphereSizeInTons = WorldAreaInM2 * AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 where WorldAreaInM2 = (Dimensions.x * 10) * (Dimensions.y * 10). In example for 1km² (1000000m²) world with atmosphere pressure 1 kg/m² it will be 1000000 tons, resulting in 1 PPM per 1 ton of pollution or absorb (1 PPM = 1000000 * tons / AtmosphereSizeInTons), increasing pressure to 2 will result in 0.5 PPM per ton.
trans-unit.target: La pressione atmosferica usata nella formula della dimensione atmosferica. Gli alberi assorbono e l'inquinamento prodotto dalle tabelle in tonnellate e convertito in PPM dividendo sulla dimensione atmosferica totale. AtmosphereSizeInTons = WorldAreaInM2 * AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 dove WorldAreaInM2 = (Dimensioni.x * 10) * (Dimensioni.y * 10). Ad esempio per un mondo di 1km² (1000000m²) con pressione atmosferica di 1 kg/m² saranno 1000000 tonnellate, risultando in 1 PPM per 1 tonnellata di inquinamento o assorbimento (1 PPM = 1000000 * T / AtmosphereSizeInTons), aumentare la pressione a 2 risulterà in 0.5 PPM per tonnellata.

trans-unit.source: A fancy ashlar stone table that has been adorned with gold.

trans-unit.id: All citizens are survivalists in the world of Eco. How can you save the world if you can't save yourself?
trans-unit.source: All citizens are survivalists in the world of Eco. How can you save the world if you can't save yourself?
trans-unit.target: Tutti i cittadini sono sopravvissuti nel mondo di Eco. Come puoi salvare il mondo, se non puoi salvare te stesso?

trans-unit.id: Metal is an important part of progress and smelting is the first step into a new age. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Metal is an important part of progress and smelting is the first step into a new age. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: Il metallo è una parte importante del progresso e, fonderlo, è il primo passo per una nuova era. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette correlate.

trans-unit.id: Self-improvement increases both the amount of weight citizens can carry and their stomach capacity. It also decreases the calories expended when using hammers and shovels. Experience is gained when leveling up other specialties.
trans-unit.source: Self-improvement increases both the amount of weight citizens can carry and their stomach capacity. It also decreases the calories expended when using hammers and shovels. Experience is gained when leveling up other specialties.
trans-unit.target: Il miglioramento personale incrementa sia la quantità di peso trasportabile dai cittadini che la capacità dei loro stomaci. Riduce inoltre le calorie consumate usando martelli e pale. L'esperienza è ottenuta facendo salire di livello le altre specialità.

trans-unit.id: Pottery is an advancement in masonry and can provide an excellent building material for communities. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Pottery is an advancement in masonry and can provide an excellent building material for communities. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: La ceramica è un avanzamento della muratura e può fornire un eccellente materiale da costruzione per le comunità. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette correlate.

trans-unit.id: Paper to carry the written word. Or used to stuff in bookshelves. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Paper to carry the written word. Or used to stuff in bookshelves. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: Carta per trasportare la parola scritta. O usata per riempire gli scaffali. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette correlate.

trans-unit.id: While it takes some advanced tools and constructions, harvesting and refining oil can be an important step. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: While it takes some advanced tools and constructions, harvesting and refining oil can be an important step. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: Sebbene richiedano strumenti e costruzioni avanzati, la raccolta e raffinazione del petrolio possono essere un passo importante. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette correlate.

trans-unit.id: Hitting rocks with a pickaxe can be surprisingly difficult. Levels up by breaking rocks.
trans-unit.source: Hitting rocks with a pickaxe can be surprisingly difficult. Levels up by breaking rocks.
trans-unit.target: Colpire le rocce con un piccone può esser sorprendentemente difficile. Aumenta di livello rompendo le rocce.

trans-unit.id: Milling various products can create important materials for baking and other uses. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Milling various products can create important materials for baking and other uses. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: Fresare vari prodotti può creare materiali importanti per la cottura e altri usi. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette correlate.

trans-unit.id: Mechanics for more advanced creations. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Mechanics for more advanced creations. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: Meccanica per creazioni più avanzate. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette correlate.

trans-unit.id: Rocks and mortar can provide a suitable building material alternative to wood. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Rocks and mortar can provide a suitable building material alternative to wood. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: Rocce e mortaio possono fornire un materiale da costruzione alternativo idoneo, alternativo al legno. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette correlate.

trans-unit.id: Wood is a useful resource and cutting down trees is a skill anyone can appreciate. Levels up by felling trees and clearing debris.
trans-unit.source: Wood is a useful resource and cutting down trees is a skill anyone can appreciate. Levels up by felling trees and clearing debris.
trans-unit.target: Il legno è un'utile risorsa e l'abbattimento degli alberi è un'abilità che chiunque può apprezzare. Aumenta di livello abbattendo alberi e rimuovendone i detriti.

trans-unit.id: Advanced industrialization to produce larger machines and advanced technology. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Advanced industrialization to produce larger machines and advanced technology. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: Industrializzazione avanzata per produrre macchinari più grandi e tecnologie avanzate. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette correlate.

trans-unit.id: Hunt animals for skin and meat. Levels up by successfully hunting.
trans-unit.source: Hunt animals for skin and meat. Levels up by successfully hunting.
trans-unit.target: Caccia gli animali per la pelle e la carne. Aumenta di livello cacciando con successo.

trans-unit.id: Glassworkers have improved ability to create glass which can be used as a clear building material or framed in steel to create a more industrial look. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Glassworkers have improved ability to create glass which can be used as a clear building material or framed in steel to create a more industrial look. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: I vetrai hanno un'abilità migliorata per creare il vetro, utilizzabile come materiale da costruzione trasparente o incorniciato nell'acciaio per un aspetto più industriale. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette correlate.

trans-unit.id: Gathering covers harvesting materials from both the natural environment and human-created farms. Levels up by gathering plants - farmed or natural.
trans-unit.source: Gathering covers harvesting materials from both the natural environment and human-created farms. Levels up by gathering plants - farmed or natural.
trans-unit.target: La Raccolta copre i materiali raccolti sia dall'ambiente naturale che dalle fattorie artificiali. Aumenta di livello raccogliendo piante, coltivate o naturali.

trans-unit.id: Adding additional nutrients to the soil can improve farming yield or, if overdone, ruin it. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Adding additional nutrients to the soil can improve farming yield or, if overdone, ruin it. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: L'aggiunta di nutrienti al suolo può migliorare la resa agricola o, se eccessiva, rovinarla. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette correlate.

trans-unit.id: The art of planting and cultivating flora. Levels up by crafting related recipes and using the hoe.
trans-unit.source: The art of planting and cultivating flora. Levels up by crafting related recipes and using the hoe.
trans-unit.target: L'arte di piantare e coltivare la flora. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette correlate e usando la zappa.

trans-unit.id: Electronics improves the recipes for many advanced materials needed for advanced technology. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Electronics improves the recipes for many advanced materials needed for advanced technology. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: L'elettronica migliora le ricette per molti materiali avanzati necessari per le tecnologie avanzate. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette correlate.

trans-unit.id: Cutting edge cooking works with ingredients that don't quite sound like food but can potentially provide high calorie and nutrition. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Cutting edge cooking works with ingredients that don't quite sound like food but can potentially provide high calorie and nutrition. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: La cucina d'avanguardia opera con ingredienti che non sembrano nemmeno cibo, ma possono potenzialmente fornire calorie e nutrimento elevati. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette correlate.

trans-unit.id: The basics of cooking in a more civilized environment give bonuses to a variety of food recipes. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: The basics of cooking in a more civilized environment give bonuses to a variety of food recipes. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: Le basi della cucina in un ambiente più civilizzato danno bonus a numerose ricette alimentari. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette correlate.

trans-unit.id: Allows the construction of advanced wood products for furniture and houses. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Allows the construction of advanced wood products for furniture and houses. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: Consente la costruzione di prodotti avanzati in legno per mobili e abitazioni. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette correlate.

trans-unit.id: Cutting logs into usable crafting and building materials is an important skill for budding communities. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Cutting logs into usable crafting and building materials is an important skill for budding communities. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: Tagliare i tronchi in materiali da fabbricazione e costruzione utilizzabili è un'importante abilità per creare comunità. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette correlate.

trans-unit.id: Advanced techniques for producing food over a campfire with a little less burned and a little more golden brown. Levels up by crafting campfire recipes.
trans-unit.source: Advanced techniques for producing food over a campfire with a little less burned and a little more golden brown. Levels up by crafting campfire recipes.
trans-unit.target: Tecniche avanzate per produrre alimenti un po' meno bruciati e più dorati su un fuoco da campo. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette correlate.

trans-unit.id: Butchery allows for more usable products to be harvested from hunted animals and fish. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Butchery allows for more usable products to be harvested from hunted animals and fish. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: La macelleria consente la raccolta di prodotti più utilizzabili da selvaggina e pesci. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette correlate.

trans-unit.id: Basic Engineering allows easier construction of roads and gives access to early forms of mechanical power. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Basic Engineering allows easier construction of roads and gives access to early forms of mechanical power. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: L'Ingegneria di Base consente una più facile costruzione delle strade e dà accesso alle prime forme di energia meccanica. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette correlate.

trans-unit.id: An introduction to cooking with an oven. Levels up by crafting related unleavened recipes.
trans-unit.source: An introduction to cooking with an oven. Levels up by crafting related unleavened recipes.
trans-unit.target: Un'introduzione alla cucina con un forno. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette non lievitate correlate.

trans-unit.id: Advanced smelting aids in the production of steel - a key ingredient in the progress of any group. Levels up by crafting advanced smelting recipes.
trans-unit.source: Advanced smelting aids in the production of steel - a key ingredient in the progress of any group. Levels up by crafting advanced smelting recipes.
trans-unit.target: La fusione avanzata aiuta nella produzione dell'acciaio, un ingrediente chiave nel progresso di ogni gruppo. Aumenta di livello fabbricando ricette di fusione avanzate.

trans-unit.id: Advanced masonry allows the production of high-quality stone furniture and material for houses. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Advanced masonry allows the production of high-quality stone furniture and material for houses. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: La muratura avanzata consente la produzione di mobili e materiali per abitazioni in pietra d'alta qualità. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette correlate.

trans-unit.id: Advanced cooking techniques for producing more complex foods. Levels up by crafting advanced cooking recipes.
trans-unit.source: Advanced cooking techniques for producing more complex foods. Levels up by crafting advanced cooking recipes.
trans-unit.target: Tecniche di cucina avanzata per produrre alimenti più complessi. Aumenta di livello fabbricando ricette di cucina avanzate.

trans-unit.id: Advanced baking mostly improves recipes that involve a leavening agent. Levels up by crafting advanced baking recipes.
trans-unit.source: Advanced baking mostly improves recipes that involve a leavening agent. Levels up by crafting advanced baking recipes.
trans-unit.target: La cottura avanzata migliora principalmente le ricette coinvolgenti un agente lievitante. Aumenta di livello fabbricando le ricette di cottura avanzate.

trans-unit.id: Basic Upgrade that greatly increases efficiency when crafting Tailoring recipes.
trans-unit.source: Basic Upgrade that greatly increases efficiency when crafting Tailoring recipes.
trans-unit.target: Aggiornamento di Base che aumenta largamente l'efficienza fabbricando le ricette di Sartoria.

trans-unit.id: Modern Upgrade that greatly increases efficiency when crafting Tailoring recipes.
trans-unit.source: Modern Upgrade that greatly increases efficiency when crafting Tailoring recipes.
trans-unit.target: Aggiornamento Moderno che aumenta largamente l'efficienza fabbricando le ricette di Sartoria.

trans-unit.id: Modern Upgrade that greatly increases efficiency when crafting Mechanics recipes.

trans-unit.id: This clause will grant the contractor authorization to the selected object or property. Authorization can be granted temporarily for the length of the contract, or it can be given permanently. This permission can be given at either the beginning or end of the contract.\n\nIf you need a player to deliver something in a private container, or build on private land, you'll need to set their permissions with this clause to ensure they have access. Players accepting a contract should always ensure that they will receive the needed permissions to perform it.
trans-unit.source: This clause will grant the contractor authorization to the selected object or property. Authorization can be granted temporarily for the length of the contract, or it can be given permanently. This permission can be given at either the beginning or end of the contract.\n\nIf you need a player to deliver something in a private container, or build on private land, you'll need to set their permissions with this clause to ensure they have access. Players accepting a contract should always ensure that they will receive the needed permissions to perform it.
trans-unit.target: Questa clausola garantirà al contraente l'autorizzazione all'oggetto o la proprietà selezionati. L'autorizzazione può essere concessa temporaneamente per la durata del contratto, o permanentemente. Questa autorizzazione può esser data all'inizio o al termine del contratto.\n\nSe necessiti che un giocatore consegni qualcosa in un contenitore privato, o di costruire un terreno privato, dovrai impostarne le autorizzazioni con questa clausola, per assicurarti che vi abbiano accesso. I giocatori che accettano un contratto dovrebbero sempre assicurarsi che riceveranno le autorizzazioni necessarie per eseguirlo.

trans-unit.id: This setting defines how plants will be grouped when the world generates. It have two levels of grouping: clusters and groups. A cluster is a large area of the world where a particular type of plant exists, and it affects gameplay by limiting where specific plants can be spawned. Groups are primarily for visual purposes, so plants of the same species grow together with only a small distance between them.
trans-unit.source: This setting defines how plants will be grouped when the world generates. It have two levels of grouping: clusters and groups. A cluster is a large area of the world where a particular type of plant exists, and it affects gameplay by limiting where specific plants can be spawned. Groups are primarily for visual purposes, so plants of the same species grow together with only a small distance between them.
trans-unit.target: Quest'impostazione definisce come saranno raggruppate le piante alla generazione del mondo. Dispone di due livelli di raggruppamento: cluster e gruppi. Un cluster è una grande area del mondo in cui esiste un tipo particolare di pianta, e influenza il gioco limitando dove possono generarsi delle piante specifiche. I gruppi hanno uno scopo principalmente visivo, quindi, le piante della stessa specie crescono insieme, con soltanto una piccola distanza tra di esse.

trans-unit.id: A large, carnivorous canid with a distinctive howl, found in a variety of habitats around the world. They are a keystone species in many ecosystems, and are known for their social behavior and cooperative hunting strategies.
trans-unit.source: A large, carnivorous canid with a distinctive howl, found in a variety of habitats around the world. They are a keystone species in many ecosystems, and are known for their social behavior and cooperative hunting strategies.
trans-unit.target: Un grande canide carnivoro dall'ululato caratteristico, presente in una varietà di habitat in tutto il mondo. Sono una specie fondamentale in molti ecosistemi, e sono noti per il proprio comportamento sociale e per le proprie strategie cooperative di caccia.

trans-unit.id: A large bird with distinctive plumage and a fleshy wattle on its neck, which can change color based on its mood. Turkeys are highly social and known for their impressive vocalizations, including the famous gobble.
trans-unit.source: A large bird with distinctive plumage and a fleshy wattle on its neck, which can change color based on its mood. Turkeys are highly social and known for their impressive vocalizations, including the famous gobble.
trans-unit.target: Un grande uccello dal piumaggio distintivo e un bargiglio carnoso sul collo, capace di cambiare colore a seconda del proprio umore. I tacchini sono altamente sociali e noti per le loro incredibili vocalizzazioni, incluso il famoso gloglottio.

trans-unit.id: A freshwater turtle with a distinctive hooked beak and powerful jaws, known for their aggressive behavior and ability to live in a wide range of aquatic habitats.
trans-unit.source: A freshwater turtle with a distinctive hooked beak and powerful jaws, known for their aggressive behavior and ability to live in a wide range of aquatic habitats.
trans-unit.target: Una testuggine con un becco a uncino distintivo e potenti mandibole, nota per il suo comportamento aggressivo e l'abilità di vivere in un'ampia varietà di habitat acquatici.

trans-unit.id: A highly social rodent that lives in extensive underground burrows, with multiple entrances and tunnels. They use a distinctive bark-like call to communicate with other members of their colony, including to alert them of potential predators.
trans-unit.source: A highly social rodent that lives in extensive underground burrows, with multiple entrances and tunnels. They use a distinctive bark-like call to communicate with other members of their colony, including to alert them of potential predators.
trans-unit.target: Un roditore altamente sociale che vive in ampie tane sotterranee, con numerose entrate e tunnel. Utilizzano un richiamo distintivo simile a un abbaio per comunicare con gli altri membri della propria colonia, oltre che per avvisarli di potenziali predatori.

trans-unit.id: A playful and agile semi-aquatic mammal, often seen floating on their backs or playing with objects in the water. Otters have a thick, waterproof fur coat that keeps them warm in cold water, and webbed feet that make them excellent swimmers.
trans-unit.source: A playful and agile semi-aquatic mammal, often seen floating on their backs or playing with objects in the water. Otters have a thick, waterproof fur coat that keeps them warm in cold water, and webbed feet that make them excellent swimmers.
trans-unit.target: Un giocoso e agile mammifero semiacquatico, spesso osservato a galleggiare sul proprio dorso o a giocare con oggetti nell'acqua. Le lontre hanno una spessa pelliccia idrorepellente che le tiene al caldo nelle acque fredde, e zampe palmate che le rendono eccellenti nuotatrici.

trans-unit.id: A wild goat species with shaggy white fur and curved horns, adapted to live in steep, rocky terrain. Their cloven hooves provide excellent traction and their white coat helps them blend in with their snowy surroundings.
trans-unit.source: A wild goat species with shaggy white fur and curved horns, adapted to live in steep, rocky terrain. Their cloven hooves provide excellent traction and their white coat helps them blend in with their snowy surroundings.
trans-unit.target: Una specie di capra selvatica con una pelosa pelliccia bianca e corna ricurve, adattata a vivere in terreni scoscesi e rocciosi. I suoi zoccoli fessi forniscono un'eccellente trazione e il suo manto bianco la aiuta a mimetizzarsi con i suoi nevosi dintorni.

trans-unit.id: A large wild cat with distinctive black spots and a muscular build, often found in dense rainforests. Jaguars are apex predators and have no natural enemies, although they can be threatened by habitat loss and poaching.
trans-unit.source: A large wild cat with distinctive black spots and a muscular build, often found in dense rainforests. Jaguars are apex predators and have no natural enemies, although they can be threatened by habitat loss and poaching.
trans-unit.target: Un grande felino selvatico con macchie nere caratteristiche e una corporatura robusta, spesso presente nelle dense foreste pluviali. I giaguari sono predatori alfa privi di nemici naturali, sebbene possano essere minacciati dalla perdita del habitat e dal bracconaggio.

trans-unit.id: A fast and agile mammal, characterized by its long ears and powerful hind legs. Hares are generally larger and faster than rabbits, and they typically have a more solitary lifestyle.
trans-unit.source: A fast and agile mammal, characterized by its long ears and powerful hind legs. Hares are generally larger and faster than rabbits, and they typically have a more solitary lifestyle.
trans-unit.target: Un mammifero agile e veloce, caratterizzato dalle sue lunghe orecchie e potenti zampe posteriori. Le lepri sono generalmente più grandi e veloci dei conigli e, tipicamente, hanno uno stile di vita più solitario.

trans-unit.id: A small and agile canid with a reddish-orange fur coat and a bushy tail. Foxes are known for their intelligence and problem-solving skills, and have been observed using tools and displaying advanced problem-solving abilities in the wild.
trans-unit.source: A small and agile canid with a reddish-orange fur coat and a bushy tail. Foxes are known for their intelligence and problem-solving skills, and have been observed using tools and displaying advanced problem-solving abilities in the wild.
trans-unit.target: Un piccolo e a gile canide con un manto di pelliccia rosso-arancione e una folta coda. Le volpi sono note per la loro intelligenza e le loro abilità di risoluzione dei problemi, e sono state osservate a utilizzare strumenti e mostrare avanzate abilità risolutive in natura.

trans-unit.id: A majestic deer species found in forests and grasslands, characterized by its large antlers and brownish-gray coat. Male elk, also called bulls, grow and shed their antlers annually, which can reach up to 1.2 meters (4 feet) in length.
trans-unit.source: A majestic deer species found in forests and grasslands, characterized by its large antlers and brownish-gray coat. Male elk, also called bulls, grow and shed their antlers annually, which can reach up to 1.2 meters (4 feet) in length.
trans-unit.target: Una maestosa specie di cervo presente in foreste e praterie, caratterizzata dai suoi grandi palchi e dal suo mantello grigio brunastro. I palchi degli alci maschi crescono e cadono annualmente, raggiungendo lunghezze fino a 1,2 metri.

trans-unit.id: A graceful, herbivorous mammal with a reddish-brown coat that inhabits forests and fields. Deer have evolved a variety of adaptations to avoid predators, such as their excellent sense of hearing, smell, and vision, as well as their ability to run fast and jump high.
trans-unit.source: A graceful, herbivorous mammal with a reddish-brown coat that inhabits forests and fields. Deer have evolved a variety of adaptations to avoid predators, such as their excellent sense of hearing, smell, and vision, as well as their ability to run fast and jump high.
trans-unit.target: Un grazioso mammifero erbivoro con un mantello bruno-rossastro che abita le foreste e i campi. I cervi hanno evoluto una varietà di adattamenti per evitare i predatori, quali il loro eccellente senso di udito, odorato e vista, nonché la loro abilità di correre veloci e saltare in alto.

trans-unit.id: A crustacean with a hard exoskeleton and two large pincers used for defense, feeding, and courtship displays. Crabs are omnivores and feed on a variety of foods, including algae, other invertebrates, and carrion.
trans-unit.source: A crustacean with a hard exoskeleton and two large pincers used for defense, feeding, and courtship displays. Crabs are omnivores and feed on a variety of foods, including algae, other invertebrates, and carrion.
trans-unit.target: Un crostaceo con un duro esoscheletro e due grandi chele utilizzate per difesa, alimentazione e corteggiamento. I granchi sono onnivori e si nutrono di numerosi alimenti, incluse alghe, altri invertebrati e carcasse.

trans-unit.id: A clever and adaptable canid with a bushy tail and distinctive howling and yipping vocalizations. Known for their scavenging and hunting abilities, coyotes can be found in many different habitats.

trans-unit.target: Un intelligente, adattabile canide con una folta coda e distintive vocalizzazioni di ululato e lamento. Noto per le sue abilità di soprofagia e caccia, i coyote si possono trovare in molti habitat differenti.

trans-unit.id: A massive, shaggy mammal with a large head, humped shoulders, and distinctive curved horns. Often seen grazing on grasslands and prairies, bison are an important example of a species that has made a remarkable comeback from the brink of extinction due to conservation efforts.
trans-unit.source: A massive, shaggy mammal with a large head, humped shoulders, and distinctive curved horns. Often seen grazing on grasslands and prairies, bison are an important example of a species that has made a remarkable comeback from the brink of extinction due to conservation efforts.
trans-unit.target: Un enorme mammifero peloso dalla grande testa, spalle gobbe e corna ricurve caratteristiche. Spesso visto pascolare in praterie e distese erbose, il bisonte è un importante esempio di specie sull'orlo dell'estinzione, tornate notevolmente grazie ai programmi di conservazione.

trans-unit.id: These wild ungulates are known for their distinctive curved horns, which are used for dominance battles and display during the mating season. They are well adapted to harsh environments and are found in both mountainous and desert regions.

trans-unit.id: A large, scaly reptile with a powerful bite and a long tail, commonly found near rivers, swamps, and lakes in warm regions. Alligators are ancient creatures that have remained virtually unchanged for millions of years.
trans-unit.source: A large, scaly reptile with a powerful bite and a long tail, commonly found near rivers, swamps, and lakes in warm regions. Alligators are ancient creatures that have remained virtually unchanged for millions of years.
trans-unit.target: Un grande rettile squamoso dal potente morso e la coda lunga, comunemente presente vicino a fiumi, paludi e laghi, nelle regioni calde. Gli alligatori sono creature antiche, che sono rimaste praticamente invariate per milioni di anni.

trans-unit.id: When an annexation happens, the resources used in the anneaxtion will have this percent destroyed, with the rest given to the non-abandoned citizens of the target of the annex. These are wasted resources due to forcing an action rather than coming to an agreement. 1 means destroy everything, .5 means destroy half, 0 means destroy none.

Queste sono le risorse sprecate a causa di un'azione forzata, piuttosto che provenienti da un accordo. 1 significa distruggi tutto, .5 significa distruggi metà, 0 significa non distruggere nulla.

trans-unit.source: When new Citizens are permitted, settlement requirements must be met to apply. Enabling 'Allow New People To Instantly Join' allows immediate joining for new Citizens.
trans-unit.target: Quando vengono ammessi nuovi cittadini, è necessario soddisfare i requisiti di insediamento per poter presentare domanda. Abilitando l'opzione "Consenti ai nuovi arrivati di unirsi immediatamente" si permette l'adesione immediata dei nuovi cittadini.

trans-unit.source: Citizens failing to meet ongoing requirements are granted time for compliance. Failure to meet requirements post-deadline results in citizenship revocation.
trans-unit.target: Ai cittadini che non riescono a soddisfare i requisiti in corso viene concesso del tempo per mettersi in regola. Il mancato rispetto dei requisiti dopo la scadenza comporta la revoca della cittadinanza.

trans-unit.source: Determines how fast the game progresses, with 30 days being the normal progression. When set faster, the meteor will hit sooner but you will gain skill faster and crafting will take less time.
trans-unit.target: Determina la velocità di avanzamento del gioco, con 30 giorni come durata standard. Se imposti una velocità maggiore, la meteora colpirà prima, ma acquisirai abilità più rapidamente e la creazione di oggetti richiederà meno tempo.
Limita le ore di gioco al giorno

trans-unit.id: When set, citizens will become exhausted after the given number of hours. While exhausted, they cannot spend calories, but can still do other activities like making culture, etc. This setting is used to prevent some players from getting ahead of everyone else by playing many more hours than everyone else.
trans-unit.source: When set, citizens will become exhausted after the given number of hours. While exhausted, they cannot spend calories, but can still do other activities like making culture, etc. This setting is used to prevent some players from getting ahead of everyone else by playing many more hours than everyone else.
trans-unit.target: Una volta impostato, i cittadini si esauriranno dopo un determinato numero di ore. Quando sono esausti, non possono consumare calorie, ma possono comunque svolgere altre attività come la creazione di cultura, ecc. Questa impostazione serve a impedire che alcuni giocatori superino tutti gli altri giocando molte più ore rispetto agli altri.

trans-unit.id: Expected number of players that will be contributing towards the meteor. Adjusting this will change the number of specialties each person can take (depending on collaboration level).
trans-unit.source: Expected number of players that will be contributing towards the meteor. Adjusting this will change the number of specialties each person can take (depending on collaboration level).
trans-unit.target: Numero previsto di giocatori che contribuiranno alla missione contro la meteora. Modificando questo valore cambierà il numero di specializzazioni che ogni persona potrà scegliere (a seconda del livello di collaborazione).

trans-unit.id: How much collaboration citizens are expected to take part in. High collaboration means everyone will be highly reliant on the society functioning properly. No collaboration means no dependence is required, but you can still trade.
trans-unit.source: How much collaboration citizens are expected to take part in. High collaboration means everyone will be highly reliant on the society functioning properly. No collaboration means no dependence is required, but you can still trade.
trans-unit.target: Quanto ci si aspetta che i cittadini collaborino. Un alto livello di collaborazione significa che tutti dipenderanno fortemente dal corretto funzionamento della società. Nessuna collaborazione significa che non è richiesta alcuna dipendenza, ma puoi comunque commerciare.

trans-unit.id: How strictly do you want to simulate logisitics like transport, inventory carry size, etc. Higher settings will make transport more important (you will need vehicles to move large quantities) and lower settings will allow individuals to carry large amounts, removing need for vehicles.
trans-unit.source: How strictly do you want to simulate logisitics like transport, inventory carry size, etc. Higher settings will make transport more important (you will need vehicles to move large quantities) and lower settings will allow individuals to carry large amounts, removing need for vehicles.
trans-unit.target: Quanto vuoi simulare in modo realistico aspetti logistici come i trasporti, la capacità di carico, ecc.? Impostazioni più elevate renderanno i trasporti più importanti (avrai bisogno di veicoli per spostare grandi quantità), mentre impostazioni più basse permetteranno alle persone di trasportare grandi quantità, eliminando la necessità di veicoli.

trans-unit.id: Defines the price that will be paid if all parts are fully broken to be totally replaced. If parts are partially broken, a prorated amount will be charged based on how percentage broken (ie, repairing 50% broken pays out 50% of this price)
trans-unit.source: Defines the price that will be paid if all parts are fully broken to be totally replaced. If parts are partially broken, a prorated amount will be charged based on how percentage broken (ie, repairing 50% broken pays out 50% of this price)

trans-unit.id: How old records can be grouped. It means it will try to process all last X days of records to group them. trans-unit.source: How old records can be grouped. It means it will try to process all last X days of records to group them. Usually you want to have this number low (1-2) in order to avoid process already processed records, but you can set high value (by example world age) in order to process at once all records from some old save with disabled grouping.
trans-unit.target: Come raggruppare i vecchi record. Significa che cercherà di elaborare tutti i record degli ultimi X giorni per raggrupparli. Di solito è meglio impostare un numero basso (1-2) per evitare di rielaborare record già elaborati, ma puoi impostare un valore alto (ad esempio l'età del mondo) per elaborare in una volta tutti i record di un vecchio salvataggio con il raggruppamento disabilitato.

trans-unit.id: Chunk dimensions of the world along X-Z. Both dimensions must have the same value and be divisible by 4. World size has limits but they usually apply when world size bigger than 250x250. If you want size bigger -> then MaxBuildHeight must be less than 320. Example: Size 300 has 238 max height, 400 has 134, etc.
trans-unit.source: Chunk dimensions of the world along X-Z. Both dimensions must have the same value and be divisible by 4. World size has limits but they usually apply when world size bigger than 250x250. If you want size bigger -> then MaxBuildHeight must be less than 320. Example: Size 300 has 238 max height, 400 has 134, etc.
trans-unit.target: Dimensioni dei chunk del mondo lungo gli assi X-Z. Entrambe le dimensioni devono avere lo stesso valore ed essere divisibili per 4. Le dimensioni del mondo hanno dei limiti, ma di solito si applicano quando il mondo è più grande di 250x250. Se vuoi dimensioni maggiori - > allora MaxBuildHeight deve essere inferiore a 320. Esempio: la dimensione 300 ha un'altezza massima di 238, la 400 ne ha 134, ecc.

trans-unit.id: Maximum height of the world citizens may build to. Can't be lowered after world creation. Note that values bigger than 160 will heavily increase CPU and RAM resources needed for world. Has hard limit for 320. Should not be lower than MaxGenerationHeight. World dimensions product ((Length * 10) * MaxBuildHeight * (Width * 10)) must be less than max value if INT, so values can be clamped to lower on server start.
trans-unit.source: Maximum height of the world citizens may build to. Can't be lowered after world creation. Note that values bigger than 160 will heavily increase CPU and RAM resources needed for world. Has hard limit for 320. Should not be lower than MaxGenerationHeight. World dimensions product ((Length * 10) * MaxBuildHeight * (Width * 10)) must be less than max value if INT, so values can be clamped to lower on server start.
trans-unit.target: Altezza massima che i cittadini del mondo possono raggiungere. Non può essere abbassata dopo la creazione del mondo. Tieni presente che valori superiori a 160 aumenteranno notevolmente le risorse di CPU e RAM necessarie per il mondo. Ha un limite massimo di 320. Non dovrebbe essere inferiore a MaxGenerationHeight. Il prodotto delle dimensioni del mondo ((Lunghezza * 10) * MaxBuildHeight * (Larghezza * 10)) deve essere inferiore al valore massimo se INT, quindi i valori possono essere limitati a un valore inferiore all'avvio del server.

trans-unit.id: Specifies the formula or curve that controls the shape of how the audio fades between the ConversationalDistance and the AudibleDistance. (1:InverseByDistance) - Fades voice quickly at first, buts slows down as you get further from conversational distance. (2:LinearByDistance) - Fades voice slowly at first, but speeds up as you get further from conversational distance. (3:ExponentialByDistance) - Voice within conversational distance is louder, but fades quickly beyond it.
trans-unit.source: Specifies the formula or curve that controls the shape of how the audio fades between the ConversationalDistance and the AudibleDistance. (1:InverseByDistance) - Fades voice quickly at first, buts slows down as you get further from conversational distance. (2:LinearByDistance) - Fades voice slowly at first, but speeds up as you get further from conversational distance. (3:ExponentialByDistance) - Voice within conversational distance is louder, but fades quickly beyond it.
trans-unit.target: Specifica la formula o la curva che controlla la forma con cui l'audio si attenua tra la ConversationalDistance e l'AudibleDistance. (1:InverseByDistance) - Attenua rapidamente la voce all'inizio, ma rallenta man mano che ti allontani dalla distanza di conversazione. (2:LinearByDistance) - Attenua lentamente la voce all'inizio, ma accelera man mano che ti allontani dalla distanza di conversazione. (3:ExponentialByDistance) - La voce entro la distanza di conversazione è più forte, ma si attenua rapidamente oltre tale distanza.

trans-unit.id: Defines how the penalty percentage scales between the start and maximum pollution values. Possible values: Linear (penalty increases uniformly), Exponential (penalty increases slowly at first, then rapidly at high pollution), Logarithmic (penalty is strong at low pollution, then flattens at higher values), DoubleSigmoid (penalty increases strongly at low pollution, slows near mid-range, then increases strongly again near maximum pollution).
trans-unit.source: Defines how the penalty percentage scales between the start and maximum pollution values. Possible values: Linear (penalty increases uniformly), Exponential (penalty increases slowly at first, then rapidly at high pollution), Logarithmic (penalty is strong at low pollution, then flattens at higher values), DoubleSigmoid (penalty increases strongly at low pollution, slows near mid-range, then increases strongly again near maximum pollution).
trans-unit.target: Definisce come varia la percentuale di penalità tra i valori di inquinamento iniziali e quelli massimi. Valori possibili: Lineare (la penalità aumenta in modo uniforme), Esponenziale (la penalità aumenta lentamente all'inizio, poi rapidamente a livelli elevati di inquinamento), Logaritmica (la penalità è forte a bassi livelli di inquinamento, poi si appiattisce a valori più alti), Doppia sigmoide (la penalità aumenta fortemente a bassi livelli di inquinamento, rallenta vicino alla fascia media, poi aumenta di nuovo fortemente vicino al massimo livello di inquinamento).

trans-unit.id:
Defines a set of blocks that must exist, or not exist on a property. This can be used for all kinds of things:
 - Removing unwanted plants
 - Removing pollution
 - Planting fields (planted blocks must exist)

If {Text.Info(Surface)} is checked, only surface blocks will be examined. Otherwise, blocks to a depth of {Text.Info(5)} below the highest block will be examined.
trans-unit.source:
Defines a set of blocks that must exist, or not exist on a property. This can be used for all kinds of things:
 - Removing unwanted plants
 - Removing pollution
 - Planting fields (planted blocks must exist)
 - Removing structures or obstacles.

If {Text.Info(Surface)} is checked, only surface blocks will be examined. Otherwise, blocks to a depth of {Text.Info(5)} below the highest block will be examined.
trans-unit.target:
Definisce un insieme di blocchi che devono esistere, o non esistere, su una proprietà. Questo può essere utilizzato per ogni genere di cose:
 - Rimuovere piante indesiderate
 - Rimuovere l'inquinamento
 - Piantare campi (i blocchi piantati devono esistere)
 - Rimuovere strutture o ostacoli.

Se {Text.Info(Surface)} è selezionato, verranno esaminati solo i blocchi di superficie. Altrimenti, verranno esaminati i blocchi fino a una profondità di {Text.Info(5)} sotto il blocco più alto.

trans-unit.id: This clause allows players to define in words what they would like done. When using this clause, the contract can no longer be auto-approved, and the client will have to approve it before accepting it. When accepting a contract with a custom clause, it is wise to first review the reputation of the citizen offering it, because it is fully at their discretion to approve or deny its completion.\n\nYou must uncheck {Text.Info(Auto-Approve)} at the bottom of the contract to use this clause.
trans-unit.source: This clause allows players to define in words what they would like done. When using this clause, the contract can no longer be auto-approved, and the client will have to approve it before accepting it. When accepting a contract with a custom clause, it is wise to first review the reputation of the citizen offering it, because it is fully at their discretion to approve or deny its completion.\n\nYou must uncheck {Text.Info(Auto-Approve)} at the bottom of the contract to use this clause.
trans-unit.target: Questa clausola permette ai giocatori di definire a parole ciò che vorrebbero fosse fatto. Quando si utilizza questa clausola, il contratto non può più essere approvato automaticamente e il cliente dovrà approvarlo prima di accettarlo. Quando si accetta un contratto con una clausola personalizzata, è consigliabile verificare prima la reputazione del cittadino che lo propone, poiché è a sua completa discrezione approvarne o negarne l'esecuzione. \n\nPer utilizzare questa clausola, devi deselezionare {Text.Info(Auto-Approve)} nella parte inferiore del contratto.

trans-unit.id: Defines a container that must contain a set of objects. Both you and the contractor must have access rights on the selected container.\n\nYou can automatically give the contractor access rights to the container for the term of the contract with an additional Permissions contract clause.
trans-unit.source: Defines a container that must contain a set of objects. Both you and the contractor must have access rights on the selected container.\n\nYou can automatically give the contractor access rights to the container for the term of the contract with an additional Permissions contract clause.
trans-unit.target: Definisce un contenitore che deve contenere un insieme di oggetti. Sia tu che l'appaltatore dovete avere i diritti di accesso al contenitore selezionato.\n\nPuoi concedere automaticamente all'appaltatore i diritti di accesso al contenitore per la durata del contratto con una clausola contrattuale aggiuntiva relativa alle autorizzazioni.

trans-unit.id:
This clause allows you to restrict the acceptance of a contract to only those that have a reputation equal to or greater than the defined amount.

There are two kinds of reputation you can specify here: 
 - Reputation, which is the sum of all player's ratings.
 - Relative Reputation, which is the sum of the opinions from players you have rated favorably (and who they have rated favorably, etc).

You can review the reputations of all players on the server through the citizen list, which displays players in reputation order, and displays reviews from other players in the reputation tooltip.
trans-unit.source:
This clause allows you to restrict the acceptance of a contract to only those that have a reputation equal to or greater than the defined amount.

There are two kinds of reputation you can specify here: 
 - Reputation, which is the sum of all player's ratings.
 - Relative Reputation, which is the sum of the opinions from players you have rated favorably (and who they have rated favorably, etc).

You can review the reputations of all players on the server through the citizen list, which displays players in reputation order, and displays reviews from other players in the reputation tooltip.
trans-unit.target:
Questa clausola ti permette di limitare l'accettazione di un contratto solo a chi ha una reputazione pari o superiore all'importo definito.

Ci sono due tipi di reputazione che puoi specificare qui: 
 - Reputazione, che è la somma di tutte le valutazioni del giocatore.
 - Reputazione relativa, che è la somma delle opinioni dei giocatori che hai valutato positivamente (e di chi hanno valutato positivamente loro, ecc.).

Puoi controllare la reputazione di tutti i giocatori sul server tramite l'elenco dei cittadini, che mostra i giocatori in ordine di reputazione e visualizza le recensioni degli altri giocatori nel tooltip della reputazione.

trans-unit.id:
This clause allows you to restrict the acceptance of a contract to only those that have a reputation equal to or greater than the defined amount.
There are two kinds of reputation you can specify here: - {0}, which is the sum of all player's ratings, multiplied by a network effect. - {1}, which is the sum of the opinions from players you have rated favorably (and who they have rated favorably, etc).
You can review the reputations of all players on the server through the citizen list, which displays players in reputation order, and displays reviews from other players in the reputation tooltip.
trans-unit.source:
This clause allows you to restrict the acceptance of a contract to only those that have a reputation equal to or greater than the defined amount.
There are two kinds of reputation you can specify here: - {0}, which is the sum of all player's ratings, multiplied by a network effect. - {1}, which is the sum of the opinions from players you have rated favorably (and who they have rated favorably, etc).
You can review the reputations of all players on the server through the citizen list, which displays players in reputation order, and displays reviews from other players in the reputation tooltip.
trans-unit.target:
Questa clausola ti permette di limitare l'accettazione di un contratto solo a chi ha una reputazione pari o superiore al valore definito.
Ci sono due tipi di reputazione che puoi specificare qui: - {0}, che è la somma di tutte le valutazioni del giocatore, moltiplicata per un effetto rete. - {1}, che è la somma delle opinioni dei giocatori che hai valutato positivamente (e di chi hanno valutato positivamente loro, ecc.).
Puoi controllare la reputazione di tutti i giocatori sul server tramite l'elenco dei cittadini, che mostra i giocatori in ordine di reputazione e visualizza le recensioni degli altri giocatori nel tooltip della reputazione.

trans-unit.id:
This clause will grant the contractor authorization to the selected object or property. Authorization can be granted temporarily for the length of the contract, or it can be given permanently. This permission can be given at either the beginning or end of the contract.
If you need a player to deliver something in a private container, or build on private land, you'll need to set their permissions with this clause to ensure they have access. Players accepting a contract should always ensure that they will receive the needed permissions to perform it.
trans-unit.source:
This clause will grant the contractor authorization to the selected object or property. Authorization can be granted temporarily for the length of the contract, or it can be given permanently. This permission can be given at either the beginning or end of the contract.
If you need a player to deliver something in a private container, or build on private land, you'll need to set their permissions with this clause to ensure they have access. Players accepting a contract should always ensure that they will receive the needed permissions to perform it.
trans-unit.target:
Questa clausola concederà al contraente l'autorizzazione all'oggetto o alla proprietà selezionati. L'autorizzazione può essere concessa temporaneamente per la durata del contratto, oppure può essere concessa in modo permanente. Questa autorizzazione può essere concessa all'inizio o alla fine del contratto.
Se hai bisogno che un giocatore consegni qualcosa in un contenitore privato o costruisca su un terreno privato, dovrai impostare i suoi permessi con questa clausola per assicurarti che abbia accesso. I giocatori che accettano un contratto dovrebbero sempre assicurarsi di ricevere i permessi necessari per eseguirlo.

This clause allows players to define in words what they would like done. trans-unit.id:
Render scale lets you use a 'lower resolution' while technically keeping your native resolution going. Playing at a 75% render scale will lower the load on your GPU as if it was a lower resolution while still displaying it in the proper, native resolution to avoid the blurry image.
Performance impact: High
trans-unit.source:
Render scale lets you use a 'lower resolution' while technically keeping your native resolution going. Playing at a 75% render scale will lower the load on your GPU as if it was a lower resolution while still displaying it in the proper, native resolution to avoid the blurry image.
Performance impact: High
trans-unit.target:
La scala di rendering ti permette di usare una "risoluzione inferiore" pur mantenendo tecnicamente la tua risoluzione nativa. Giocare con una scala di rendering al 75% ridurrà il carico sulla tua GPU come se fosse una risoluzione inferiore, pur continuando a visualizzare l'immagine nella corretta risoluzione nativa per evitare che risulti sfocata.
Impatto sulle prestazioni: Elevato

il Credito Cittadino (che ogni cittadino può creare in quantità illimitata) e la Valuta Garantita, che può essere creata solo in una Zecca e consuma risorse.

trans-unit.id:
Annexing a target requires paying them Claim Papers from the source settlement. Unlike resources, these 100% go to the foundation of the target without waste. The cost is determined per-non-abandoned citizen in the target.
In the case of annexing a Homestead, this number will be increased by the number of Homestead Support Claim Papers that are on the stake. This makes the support claims not only allow homesteads to claim more plots, but have more protection against annexation.
trans-unit.source:
Annexing a target requires paying them Claim Papers from the source settlement. Unlike resources, these 100% go to the foundation of the target without waste. The cost is determined per-non-abandoned citizen in the target.
In the case of annexing a Homestead, this number will be increased by the number of Homestead Support Claim Papers that are on the stake. This makes the support claims not only allow homesteads to claim more plots, but have more protection against annexation.
trans-unit.target:
Per annettere un obiettivo è necessario pagare i "Claim Papers" dall'insediamento di origine. A differenza delle risorse, questi vanno al 100% alla fondazione dell'obiettivo senza sprechi. Il costo è determinato per ogni cittadino non abbandonato nell'obiettivo.
Nel caso dell'annessione di una Homestead, questo numero sarà aumentato del numero di Documenti di rivendicazione di sostegno alla Homestead che sono in gioco. Questo fa sì che le rivendicazioni di sostegno non solo consentano alle Homestead di rivendicare più appezzamenti, ma abbiano anche una maggiore protezione contro l'annessione.

trans-unit.id:
The resources shown must exist in storage attached to an Embassy Desk that is assigned to the Settlement's jurisdiction. They must be accessible to the leader of the Settlement. The cost is determined per-non-abandoned citizen in the target.
Upon annexation, a percent of these will be given to the other party, and the rest destroyed as the cost of the annexation.
If all citizens of a target are 'Abandoned', no resources are needed.
trans-unit.source:
The resources shown must exist in storage attached to an Embassy Desk that is assigned to the Settlement's jurisdiction. They must be accessible to the leader of the Settlement. The cost is determined per-non-abandoned citizen in the target.
Upon annexation, a percent of these will be given to the other party, and the rest destroyed as the cost of the annexation.
If all citizens of a target are 'Abandoned', no resources are needed.
trans-unit.target:
Le risorse indicate devono essere conservate in un magazzino collegato a una scrivania dell'ambasciata assegnata alla giurisdizione dell'insediamento. Devono essere accessibili al leader dell'insediamento. Il costo è determinato per ogni cittadino non abbandonato nel bersaglio.
Al momento dell'annessione, una percentuale di queste risorse sarà data all'altra parte, mentre il resto verrà distrutto come costo dell'annessione.
Se tutti i cittadini di un bersaglio sono "abbandonati", non servono risorse.

trans-unit.id:
Note that 'Integrity' is not the same as 'Durability'.
Integrity is the max Durability that an object can be repaired to, which drops each time it's repaired. Repairing raises the durability of an item to the current Integrity, but Integrity can never be raised, only lowered.
trans-unit.source:
Note that 'Integrity' is not the same as 'Durability'.
Integrity is the max Durability that an object can be repaired to, which drops each time it's repaired. Repairing raises the durability of an item to the current Integrity, but Integrity can never be raised, only lowered.
trans-unit.target:
Tieni presente che "Integrità" non è la stessa cosa di "Durata".
L'Integrità è la Durata massima a cui un oggetto può essere riparato, e diminuisce ogni volta che viene riparato. Riparare aumenta la durata di un oggetto fino all'Integrità attuale, ma l'Integrità non può mai essere aumentata, solo diminuita.

This is an official Eco server provided by Strange Loop Games.

trans-unit.id: Blocks must stay connected to the ground. A block that no longer touches the ground through other blocks falls: natural blocks fall as they are, constructed blocks fall and turn into garbage (see Salvage Share). Sideways connections count, so a bridge anchored at one end is still connected: whether it can actually hold is up to Constructed Blocks Need Support.
trans-unit.source: Blocks must stay connected to the ground. A block that no longer touches the ground through other blocks falls: natural blocks fall as they are, constructed blocks fall and turn into garbage (see Salvage Share). Sideways connections count, so a bridge anchored at one end is still connected: whether it can actually hold is up to Constructed Blocks Need Support.

trans-unit.id: Constructed blocks must hold themselves up, with two numbers shown in each block's tooltip. Horizontal support: how many blocks out a block can stick out sideways (held from the side or hanging) from a column standing on the ground. Supported weight: how much structural weight piled on it a block can carry, less the further out it is. A block past its horizontal support, or carrying more than it supports, cracks, then breaks with everything it was holding. A block resting on the block under it has no horizontal limit. Weight only goes down, toward the ground, through the blocks holding it. Building against rock anchors a construction; loose ground (dirt, sand, clay, gravel) does not. Natural blocks set on a construction, like a field on a roof, weigh on it.
trans-unit.source: Constructed blocks must hold themselves up, with two numbers shown in each block's tooltip. Horizontal support: how many blocks out a block can stick out sideways (held from the side or hanging) from a column standing on the ground. Supported weight: how much structural weight piled on it a block can carry, less the further out it is. A block past its horizontal support, or carrying more than it supports, cracks, then breaks with everything it was holding. A block resting on the block under it has no horizontal limit. Weight only goes down, toward the ground, through the blocks holding it. Building against rock anchors a construction; loose ground (dirt, sand, clay, gravel) does not. Natural blocks set on a construction, like a field on a roof, weigh on it.

trans-unit.id: Natural blocks that do not rest on solid ground all the way down (cave ceilings, overhangs, the rock above a tunnel) follow the horizontal support rule of constructed blocks with each rock's own horizontal support: a ceiling spans about twice it. Constructions standing on the ground hold them up, so pillars and props save a mine. Loose ground (dirt, sand, clay, gravel) keeps a slope: a free-standing pile higher than 2 blocks slides down, unless it rests on a rock or masonry ledge or is wedged between two solids. Fallen blocks keep their type. When off, natural blocks only fall when they are disconnected (see Disconnected Blocks Fall).
trans-unit.source: Natural blocks that do not rest on solid ground all the way down (cave ceilings, overhangs, the rock above a tunnel) follow the horizontal support rule of constructed blocks with each rock's own horizontal support: a ceiling spans about twice it. Constructions standing on the ground hold them up, so pillars and props save a mine. Loose ground (dirt, sand, clay, gravel) keeps a slope: a free-standing pile higher than 2 blocks slides down, unless it rests on a rock or masonry ledge or is wedged between two solids. Fallen blocks keep their type. When off, natural blocks only fall when they are disconnected (see Disconnected Blocks Fall).

trans-unit.id: Placed objects (tables, machines, storages) fall into a garbage bag, with all their contents, when the ground under them goes or when falling blocks land on them; the bag can be picked back up. When off, objects stay where they are, even in mid-air, and falling blocks land on top of them.

trans-unit.id: Rock standing on this many rock blocks counts as solid ground, for natural blocks and as an anchor for constructions: only the layers of rock just above a void can cave in, so a cave too wide brings down a slab this thick, then the next one over a narrower opening, until it settles into a vault, instead of the whole mountain above it. Loose ground never counts. 0: only rock in an unbroken column from bedrock is ground.
